parameters.content:
## Commission Clawback & Churn Reconciliation

**Safe by default.** With no env vars this runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** on a synthetic fixture (portal 99000001): zero network calls, no files written, no CRM updates. CSVs appear only as **DRAFT** binaries in the execution.

Go-live needs explicit opt-ins:
`SANDBOX_MODE=false` · `DRY_RUN=false` · `CSV_EXPORT_ENABLED=true` · then `HUBSPOT_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true` (stamps only after a successful export).

Fail-closed: incomplete search, pending-review deals, FX gaps and amount guards block the export. Secrets only via `$env`. See README.md.

nodes.name: Reconciliation Webhook
nodes.notes: POST {"period":"YYYY-MM"} with header x-reconciliation-secret (required in live mode).

nodes.name: Monthly Schedule (3rd, 04:23)
nodes.notes: Runs for the previous calendar month. Ships inactive.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Env-only config, fail-safe flags, period resolution, webhook auth.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Churned Deals
nodes.notes: Read-only CRM search, 200 per page, <= 50 pages (HubSpot caps search at 10,000 results). Stops the run on failure: no partial payroll file.

nodes.name: Collect Search Pages
nodes.notes: Fail closed on errors, >10k results or truncated pagination.

nodes.name: Clawback Calculator
nodes.notes: 90-day window, linear/tiered/full policy, exact BigInt money math, FX, guards.

nodes.name: CSV Builder & Integrity
nodes.notes: Payroll CSV + audit CSV + manifest, SHA-256, formula-injection guard.

nodes.name: Export Allowed?
nodes.notes: Config gates AND guards (totals, pending review, FX as-of, completeness).

nodes.name: Write CSV Files to Disk
nodes.notes: Writes to CSV_EXPORT_DIR. n8n must be allowed to write there (N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Update Deals
nodes.notes: The ONLY CRM write: clawback status, amounts, reconciliation ID, processed-at.
